answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 2767 Country: India Title: Those who were killed in Gujarat, what is their status, can we call them Shahid according to Islam? Question: Those who were killed in Gujarat, what is their status, can we call them Shahid according to Islam? Answer ID: 2767 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 71/71=L) Those who were killed during riots in Gujrat are real shaheed ; they may be called as shaheed . وکذا یکون شھیداً لو قتلہ باغ او حربی الخ ( الدر المختار مع الشامی: 3/ 160 ، ط زکریا دیوبند ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
